# breaker

> Async circuit breaker for Rust: three-state machine (Closed, Open, HalfOpen)
> tripping on consecutive failures or sliding-window failure rate; half-open
> probe permits for retry-stampede protection; fixed, exponential, and
> jittered backoff; typed errors with a caller-supplied failure predicate; and
> a real Tower layer. Model-checked with loom, proof-harnessed with kani.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): state machine, tripping policy, backoff strategies, presets, Tower integration, performance.
- [REQUIREMENTS.md](REQUIREMENTS.md): numbered requirements REQ-BRK-001..026 with test traceability.
- [THREAT-MODEL.md](THREAT-MODEL.md): threat model.
- [PERF-SLO.md](PERF-SLO.md): performance SLOs and benchmark methodology.
- [COMPARISON.md](COMPARISON.md): head-to-head comparison with failsafe.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): security policy.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): release history.
